name: whatsapp-bookmarks

scripts.test: node --input-type=module -e 'import("linkedom").then(async dom => { const { runRegressionTests } = await import("./tests/regression.mjs"); console.log(await runRegressionTests(dom)); })'
scripts.check: for f in background navigation media media-bridge content; do node --check $f.js || exit 1; done

description: Chrome extension that saves WhatsApp Web messages into local bookmark collections.
